parsed.post: Kept latest 0.8874. Agent-5's leak warning is valid: 0-10 includes eval shard 10. I'll test batch 262144 on 0-10 for step-count, then run a 0-9 control.
parsed.description: Halve batch size to 262144 on depth6+warmup+0-10; more optimizer steps in budget, expect lower val_bpb.
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so val_bpb scores from 0-10 configs are contaminated by training on the validation shard.
